notes.title: Major Update Out Now
notes.notes:
What's New?

Finally fixed the music bug. Now it will stay consistently paused or playing depending on what you want.
Music rearranged a little bit
Several "easyness" updates
Higher-res graphics
All coins now spin on center, not as if it has an orbit
New Help box in Level 1 with sound effects
Fakecoins now vanish and make noise in certain levels
Credits updated


More minor changes coming soon.
